info.title: System Friction Institute External Agent API
info.description: Governed machine interface for authorized AI clients. GPT Actions authenticate with SFI OAuth. Institutional principals receive explicitly configured authority; normal accounts receive only owner-scoped personal Lab, Cognitive and Studio capabilities.

externalDocs.description: SFI Privacy & External Agent Data Policy

get.summary: Read the compact governed SFI machine console

post.summary: Get the SFI method/measurement contract for an object without sending raw content
post.description: Describe representation, function, question and objective. Supply a client-computed content hash when available.

post.summary: Return a structured analysis result to SFI without persisting the raw object
post.description: Persists structured result metadata while raw/binary/base64 content is excluded.

get.summary: Read universal open cycles or canonical history for one cycle

post.description: Supports status/intake/run/return/close for institutional signal cycles.

post.summary: Read an allowlisted governed SFI state surface
Submit a governed action proposal for ROOT review
Submit a source URL as an evidence candidate for ROOT review
post.description: The external principal may submit a candidate, but ROOT remains the acceptance authority.

post.summary: Execute an already-authorized internal SFI action
post.description: Dispatches only an already-authorized queued proposal. This endpoint cannot approve a proposal or promote canon.

post.summary: Record an observed return for an already queued proposal
Read, persist or run institutional Method Lab operations according to the operation-specific scope
post.description: Institutional Method Lab route. Personal OAuth tenants are blocked from this path and must use /api/external/v1/personal-lab.

post.summary: List, inspect, read features/content, or analyze Studio objects owned by the OAuth principal
post.description: User-bound Studio route. Every object operation resolves OAuth subject_id to studio_objects.owner_id.

post.summary: Read or run owner-scoped personal Cognitive automation
post.description: OAuth subject-bound. state requires lab:read; run requires lab:run. A normal account cannot access institutional ROOT/canonical state through this route.

207.description: Run completed with degraded automation results

post.summary: Read, create and run owner-scoped personal Lab work
post.description: OAuth subject-bound. state/report require lab:read; create_case/persist require lab:write; run requires lab:run.

207.description: Run completed with degraded automation results

post.summary: Plan, read, create and populate tenant-scoped SFI Case Platform cases
post.description: OAuth Case Platform adapter. Prefer flat systemBoundary*, temporal* and canonicalRef* transport fields. Cannot admit evidence, govern, intervene, record RETURN, or create truth claims.

200.description: Case read, intake plan or transition result

201.description: Case, source or bounded case object persisted

403.description: User-bound OAuth required or tenant access forbidden

404.description: Case not found in an accessible tenant

409.description: Case creation is missing required intake context

post.summary: Resolve required Case Platform intake before creation
post.description: Dedicated GPT Action with required boundary and cutoff transport fields. Returns intake readiness plus safe transport diagnostics. Creates no case, evidence, intervention, RETURN or truth claim.

200.description: Resolved intake plan and transport diagnostics

post.summary: Create one Case Platform case from resolved required intake
post.description: Dedicated GPT Action for case creation after intake readiness. Reconstructs canonical boundary and temporal contracts from required flat fields. Does not create accepted evidence, intervention, RETURN or truth.

403.description: User-bound OAuth required or tenant access forbidden

post.summary: Persist one bounded Case object through required flat transport
post.description: Dedicated GPT Action for Case objects. canonicalRefId and payloadJson are transport-safe required fields reconstructed inside SFI. Cannot create accepted evidence, governance, intervention, RETURN or truth claims.

403.description: User-bound OAuth required or tenant access forbidden

404.description: Case not found in an accessible tenant

post.summary: Read one tenant-scoped SFI Case Platform case
post.description: Dedicated read-only GPT Action for one Case. Ownership and tenant visibility are resolved from OAuth subject_id. This Action cannot mutate the case, admit evidence, govern, intervene, record RETURN or create truth claims.

403.description: User-bound OAuth required or tenant access forbidden

404.description: Case not found in an accessible tenant

post.summary: Apply one bounded non-intervention Case status transition
post.description: Dedicated GPT Action for Case lifecycle state. REJECTED is available when valid in the canonical state machine. INTERVENING and AWAITING_RETURN remain unavailable because intervention and observed RETURN require governed flows outside this adapter.

403.description: User-bound OAuth required or tenant access forbidden

404.description: Case not found in an accessible tenant

409.description: Transition is not valid from the current canonical Case state

get.summary: Read versioned execution-centric cognitive-agent contracts, state and execution history
get.description: Institutional read adapter over the canonical cognitive runtime and immutable execution event projection. Context, inference, telemetry and authority boundaries remain explicit.

200.description: Execution contracts/runtime list or one exact agent execution dossier

post.summary: Execute one typed cognitive-agent contract through the canonical runtime
post.description: Requires user-bound institutional OAuth, execute scope and tenant sfi. Legacy single-target request fields are rejected. Execution cannot self-approve proposals, admit evidence, perform external irreversible action, record RETURN, promote learning or promote canon.

404.description: Agent or authorized target not found

draft.description: Pre-case draft used by intake_plan. SFI returns only unresolved questions and does not create a case.

temporalMode.description: Preferred flat transport alias for temporalWindow.mode.

temporalBasis.description: Preferred flat transport alias for temporalWindow.basis.

temporalReconstructionAsOf.description: Preferred flat transport alias for temporalWindow.reconstructionAsOf.

temporalHorizon.description: Preferred flat transport alias for temporalWindow.horizon.

canonicalRefId.description: Preferred GPT Action transport field for canonicalRef.id when operation=add_object.

sfiOAuth.description: User-bound SFI identity for GPT Actions. Institutional accounts may receive explicit institutional scopes; normal accounts are reduced to owner-scoped personal workspace capabilities.

scopes.observe: Read governed institutional SFI state when the authenticated principal is allowed.
scopes.propose: Submit governed institutional proposals and evidence candidates for ROOT review.
scopes.execute: Execute only already-authorized queued institutional proposals and record proposal-scoped returns.
scopes.lab:read: Read Method Lab or personal Cognitive/Lab state permitted to the OAuth tenant.
scopes.lab:write: Persist permitted structured or owner-scoped personal Lab records.
scopes.lab:run: Run supported Method Lab or owner-scoped personal Cognitive/Lab runtimes.
scopes.studio:read: List, inspect and read features for Studio objects owned by the OAuth principal.
scopes.studio:content: Obtain a short-lived signed URL for Studio content owned by the OAuth principal.
scopes.studio:run: Run the server-side Studio analyzer for owned audio/video objects.
scopes.cases:read: Read SFI cases available to the authenticated subject through active tenant membership.
scopes.cases:write: Create and populate bounded SFI Case Platform records through authenticated tenant membership.

x-sfi-governance.principle: Observation, inference, evidence candidacy, evidence acceptance, proposal authorization, execution, return and canonical promotion remain distinct states.
x-sfi-governance.identityRule: Content fingerprint and reference-envelope hash are distinct. Never compare a referenceHash as if it were the bytes/content hash.
x-sfi-governance.personalWorkspaceBoundary: Normal OAuth accounts are tenant user:<subject_id>. Personal Cognitive, Personal Lab and Studio operations are owner-scoped and cannot access institutional proposal, execution, ROOT evidence or canonical promotion planes.
x-sfi-governance.studioOwnerBoundary: OAuth subject_id must equal studio_objects.owner_id; shared/static tokens are rejected from the external Studio route.
x-sfi-governance.publicAuthentication: OAuth only; static X-SFI-Token remains an internal server-to-server mechanism and is intentionally not advertised in this OpenAPI document.
x-sfi-governance.caseWorkspaceBoundary: Case Platform access is subject-bound and tenant-scoped. intake_plan creates no case. cases:write can create SOURCE/RECORD/INFERENCE/EPISTEMIC_ASSESSMENT objects only within the adapter allowlist; dedicated read and lifecycle Actions reuse the same canonical Case owner; REJECTED is a bounded lifecycle status, while INTERVENING and AWAITING_RETURN remain reserved. This interface cannot mint accepted EVIDENCE, GOVERNANCE_DECISION, INTERVENTION, RETURN or TRUTH_CLAIM authority.
x-sfi-governance.cognitiveRuntimeBoundary: The cognitive runtime API reuses canonical Execution Contracts and the existing execution event writer. observe is read-only; execute requires user-bound institutional OAuth. Context is not evidence, inference is not observation, model capability does not expand authority, and execution cannot imply approval, RETURN, learning or canon.
